status: proposed construction - calculated, not built or measured

requirement.part: T_BIAS4, one per phase (4 channels), driven by TI SN6505B (centre-tapped primary, 420 kHz typ)
requirement.rectifier: full bridge per secondary (PMEG4010CEJ), raw DC 25.8-30.5 V
requirement.insulation: FUNCTIONAL (B3, ARCHITECTURE-COSTFIRST.md section 2): primary <-> each secondary AND secondary <-> secondary
requirement.construction_hint: EP10-class, sectioned bobbin, triple-insulated wire on the secondaries
requirement.basis: gen/gdrv.py ext_bias_numbers() / design_check(); 5 V +/-5 % and f_min ASSUMED

construction: one per phase: DMEGC EP17 DMR44 ungapped, custom bobbin with 5 side-by-side sections separated by 0.6 mm flanges, order S1 (high side A) | S2 (low side A) | P (2 x 4 t bifilar, centre tap) | S3 (low side B) | S4 (high side B); secondaries 24 t TIW 0.16 mm; core floating; vacuum varnish dip

electrical.ratio_note: 6.0 instead of the requested 5.9 (5.9 needs 10:59, which does not fit): raw output +1.7 % (25.8-30.5 V becomes ~26.2-31.0 V)

capacitance_F.pairs: adjacent: P-S2, P-S3, S1-S2, S3-S4; one apart: P-S1, P-S4, S2-S3 (across P); two apart or more: S1-S4
capacitance_F.method: own: parallel plate between adjacent section faces through the flange (build x MLT / (t_flange/eps + t_TIW/eps + air)) + each section to the floating MnZn core (post through the tube, shell through air) taken in series + 0.3 pF pins; one apart: 20 % of the direct term (fringe)

core.asian_alternative: DMEGC is the Asian part; NiZn rejected (DN100H/DN150H Curie point 130/100 C, mu 1000-1500: more turns); sector-wound toroid rejected (coupling: commutation > 5 % of the half period)

windings.name: S1
windings.conductor: TIW 0.16 mm (three-layer, IEC 61558-2-16 / 62368-1 Annex J), 6 layers x 4

windings.name: S2
windings.conductor: TIW 0.16 mm (three-layer, IEC 61558-2-16 / 62368-1 Annex J), 6 layers x 4

windings.name: P
windings.conductor: enamelled Cu 0.40 mm grade 1, bifilar 2 x 4 t, centre tap

windings.name: S3
windings.conductor: TIW 0.16 mm (three-layer, IEC 61558-2-16 / 62368-1 Annex J), 6 layers x 4

windings.name: S4
windings.conductor: TIW 0.16 mm (three-layer, IEC 61558-2-16 / 62368-1 Annex J), 6 layers x 4

insulation.system: FUNCTIONAL (B3): TIW on every secondary + 0.6 mm bobbin flanges between sections + vacuum varnish dip (no air voids at the TIW); pins of different windings >= 5.0 mm apart (skip pin positions at 2.5 mm pitch; 3.2 mm if the board is coated); core floating

levels.label: functional, each secondary to P and to the other secondaries

insulation.routine_tests: L_half, ratio, R; PD <= 10 pC at 1750 V pk between windings (sample) or 2.5 kV DC 1 s each pair (routine); C P-S and S-S <= 5 pF at 100 kHz (sample)
insulation.type_tests: impulse 3790 V 1.2/50 between windings; thermal at 85 C ambient

core.formula: Steinmetz (DMR95 set as a stand-in for DMR44; milliwatts)

winding.formula: P = I_rms^2 R (thin wires at 420 kHz: R_ac ~ R_dc)

thermal.margins: B_pk 37 mT on A_min at f_min 350 kHz vs >= 315 mT at 100 C; Curie > 215 C (DMR44)

four_single_secondary_parts_per_phase_us.note: EP10 DMR44 + standard 2-section bobbin (no tooling), one secondary; same capacitance class (P-S ~2-3 pF on a 2-section bobbin, S-S < 0.5 pF via the board); 4 x the board area; no tooling

cost.verdict: one 4-secondary part is cheaper (1.22 vs 2.40 USD per phase at 5 k, 2.18 vs 4.40 at catalogue) once the bobbin tooling (4000 USD, 0.80 USD/part over 5 k) is paid
cost.basis: ESTIMATES, no quote: DMEGC EP17 set 13.4 g (Chinese small-core pricing); custom 5-section LCP bobbin (tooling ~4 kUSD once); TIW 0.16 mm ~0.12 USD/m (1 k) / 0.08 (5 k), 2.6 m; automated sectional winding; Lm / C / functional hipot routine test

openmagnetics.note: MAS N87 for DMR44 (same mu_i class); leakage per other winding, seen from P
